title: Servizi & sanità locale
summary: Product brief for a LocalMind consumer vertical that maps local public, health, and professional services as a weighted knowledge graph queried via GraphRAG to guide citizens from need to service.
scope: Vertical: Servizi & sanità locale (local services & healthcare consumer vertical)

Graph node types: Bisogno, Servizio, Prestazione, Ente/Organizzazione, Sede/PuntoDiAccesso, Professionista, Requisito, Documento/Modulo, Procedura/Percorso, Categoria/Tassonomia, Area territoriale, Contatto, FonteDato

Graph relation/edge types: SODDISFA, EROGATO_DA, HA_SEDE_PRESSO, RICHIEDE_PREREQUISITO, RICHIEDE_REQUISITO, RICHIEDE_DOCUMENTO, ALTERNATIVA_A, FA_PARTE_DI, APPARTIENE_A_CATEGORIA, SERVE_AREA, STEP_DI, CORRELATO_A, HA_CONTATTO, ATTESTATO_DA
Edge weighting factors: source authority, freshness/decay, semantic relevance, user feedback, usage frequency, node completeness, territorial proximity, multi-source confirmation

MVP feature set: domain schema (graph nodes/edges + Flyway), needs+services taxonomy IT/EN, HSDS connector + tabular importer, ingestion pipeline, services node/edge CRUD API, catalog editor + moderation, need-to-service GraphRAG conversational assistant, catalog search/filters, full service card, community contributions & feedback, disclaimer & emergency handling, IT/EN bilingualism

Data connectors: open-data PA (CKAN/DCAT-AP_IT), HSDS/Open Referral, FHIR Human Services Directory, institutional web scraping + Tika, PDF/flyers (Tika+OCR Tesseract), FSE 2.0 / HL7 CDA2 healthcare catalog, regional CUP, community contribution form, editorial editing, legacy Excel/CSV importer
Interchange standards: HSDS 3.x, FHIR Human Services Directory IG, CKAN/DCAT-AP_IT, HL7 CDA2/FSE 2.0, Schema.org GovernmentService/MedicalOrganization
GraphRAG use cases, KPIs/success metrics, risks & mitigations

Integration with existing LocalMind modules: knowledge graph core, llm/Ollama, Qdrant, MySQL/Flyway, document, localmind-batch, plugin (PF4J), marketplace, auth, calendar, messaging/email, mcp, automation, agent, finetuning, Angular frontend feature servizi
